headline: Rystad Energy Cuts Brazil Data Center Projections Amid Regulatory Delays
summary: Consultancy Rystad Energy reduced its projections for data center installations in Brazil from 21 gigawatts to 7 gigawatts by 2030 due to delays in law regulations.
why: Regulatory uncertainty in infrastructure laws can delay capital expenditure cycles and impact anticipated sectoral growth.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Reduced infrastructure buildout projections slow technology sector capital inflows in the country.
